notes: Across both five-run confirmations of the same unchanged code the total is 9 of 10 runs passing. VER-0001 recorded the first (5 of 5); this records the second (4 of 5). The first is not withdrawn and the second is not discarded.

Root cause of the residual failure, measured rather than inferred: warmApiRoutes gates on /api/v1/auth/login by polling until the status is not 404, but issues the dynamic-segment route in WARM_ONLY_ROUTES once and discards its status. A discarded 404 is precisely the uncompiled-route signal the gate exists to wait out, so the suite can still begin before that route's module has compiled. Run 4's failing response body was the application's HTML not-found page, not the API kernel's problem+json envelope, which is what an unmatched route returns.

Corrects a statement in VER-0001. VER-0001 records that the dynamic-slug route 'returns a legitimate 404 for an unknown workspace'. Measured on a cold dev server, an unauthenticated GET on that path returns 401 application/problem+json: route() throws Unauthorized at step 3, before parameter validation and before requireWorkspace runs, so the workspace slug is never resolved. The route can therefore be gated on the same not-404 condition as the login route. The corrective change made under VER-0001 was still the right one; the reason recorded for it was wrong.

The remedy is a one-line scope change in tests/e2e/helpers.ts: gate every warmed route on the not-404 condition instead of gating one and discarding the other. It is not applied here. SPEC-0004 is VERIFYING, the control plane refuses an IMPLEMENTER session in that state (SDD-V043), and forcing the status backwards to obtain one would be routing around the gate. Raised as CONV-004 for human disposition instead.
No retry, sleep or raised timeout was added, and no assertion was weakened, to reach this result.
